ww.h0: Two routes: Grundsicherungsgeld or housing benefit (Wohngeld)
ww.a.t0: Covers your whole need: standard rate, rent and heating, plus health insurance. In return there are duties: documents, appointments and looking for work.
ww.b.t0: A top-up to your own income, without duties at the Jobcenter.
ww.regel0: If Wohngeld together with your income covers your need, it comes first. If not, you get Grundsicherungsgeld.
gn.liste: For a more precise result, still missing: {liste}.
gn.brutto: gross pay (at the top of your payslip)
f.auf.1.fuer: Each of these benefits has its own cover letter: {liste}.
f.auf.1.form: For {liste} there is an official form (step 2). You don't need a cover letter for it.
bp.scan.p: Scan the decision letter. SoLo recalculates it and shows differences.
bp.jc.was: SoLo recalculates the amounts in your decision for one month, with the same rules as the benefits check: standard rates, additional needs, rent and heating, and the income counted. Where the decision differs to your disadvantage, SoLo shows the difference and the reason.
bp.wid.fehlt: Still missing: {liste}. That is why the objection has no reasons with figures yet. It still meets the deadline. You send the reasons later.
bp.wid.keinGrund: SoLo found no reason. That is why the objection has no reasons yet.
bp.wid.bis.t: By this day the objection must reach the office that sent the decision. Calculated: date of the decision plus 4 days for the post, then one month. If the letter arrived later, the deadline can end later.
bp.art.frage: What kind of letter is it?
bp.art.anh: Hearing (Anhörung – the office asks before it decides)
bp.art.anh.t: A hearing is not yet a decision. Briefly explain what happened and add proof. You can only object to the decision that follows.
bp.art.termin.tag: When is the appointment? (it is in the letter)
bp.datum: Date of the decision (top right of the letter)
bp.datum.t: Enter the date. SoLo then shows right away by when you can object.
bp.erk.t: SoLo read these values from the letter. Please compare them with the letter.
bp.erk.warte: Please check the recognised values first.
bp.erk.feld: Hard to read. Please check carefully.
bp.pf.p: Scan the assessment or choose a PDF. SoLo recalculates the points.
bp.sa.h: Check a decision on basic income support in old age (Grundsicherung im Alter)
bp.wg.p: Scan the Wohngeld decision. SoLo recalculates it under the Housing Benefit Act.
bp.nk.p: Scan the statement. SoLo checks deadlines and items.
bp.w.bg: Everyone the Jobcenter calculates together – you, your spouse or partner and your unmarried children under 25 in the household (§ 7 Abs. 3 SGB II).
bp.w.bb: The pages of the decision with the calculation: per person and month, what is recognised and what is deducted as income. Usually at the back.
bp.w.rb: A fixed amount for everyday life, for example food, clothing and electricity. It depends on age and on whether you live alone or as a couple (§ 20 SGB II).
bp.w.mb: An extra amount in special situations, for example for single parents, in pregnancy or if hot water is heated in the flat (§ 21 SGB II).
bp.w.kdu: Rent, service charges and heating, as far as the Jobcenter recognises them as reasonable (§ 22 SGB II).
bp.w.zb: The amount paid into your account every month.
bp.w.bz: The months the decision covers. After that you need an application to continue (Weiterbewilligungsantrag). It is not the date of the decision.
briefe.schreibenDe: Letters to authorities, for example an objection, are always in German. The authorities need them that way.
sp.vz.link: Eating healthily on little money – tips from the Verbraucherzentrale
sp.vz.t: Page of the consumer advice centre in plain language. Opens in the browser.
bp.vgl.mehr: In {n} of 6 areas the assessment gives fewer points than your estimate (marked in bold).
bp.vgl.keinMehr: In no area does the assessment give fewer points than your estimate.
bp.vgl.klein: Weighted points, as the Pflegekasse calculates them (§ 15 SGB XI). Plus means: your estimate gives more points there. Below you can see which questions exactly.
